name: SEON
description:
"SEON is the AI command center for fraud prevention and AML compliance. Use the SEON connector to filter transactions, analyze fraud score trends, investigate individual transactions, review customer risk profiles and find connected users sharing device fingerprints, IP addresses, card details, and more. All five investigation tools run against SEON's first-party data layer with access to 900+ risk signals, so Claude gets complete context in a single, token-efficient call. Ask questions and get investigation-ready answers without exporting data or switching tools. All access respects your existing SEON role-based permissions. Tools are read-only with a full audit trail recorded in the SEON activity log.
"

_published_faq.name: How do I add SEON to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SEON to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.seon.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SEON MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEON lists 17 MCP tools, including seon_filter_transactions, seon_get_account_info, seon_get_alert_triggers, seon_get_alerts, seon_get_aml_screening_info, seon_get_analytics_playbook, seon_get_customer_details, seon_get_filter_fields, seon_get_knowledge_base, seon_get_list, seon_get_platform_activity_log, and seon_get_rule_info.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SEON?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SEON in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
SEON requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SEON is developed by Seon. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
